title: The Coolest Details From Our Grand Theft Auto VI Cover Story | The Game Informer Show
summary: Alex, Marcus, Charles, and Kyle sit down to discuss the most recent cover story Grand Theft Auto VI, and what Rockstar is doing with its open world systems in the new one. - Game Informer

Marcus, Alex, Charles, and Kyle discuss how Leonida compares to Florida, the game's updated weather system and how it may compare to Red Dead Redemption 2, and speculate on what may happen to players who prey on endangered species. Later in the podcast, we discuss our time playing Star Wars: Galactic Racer and End of Abyss, the latter being a new survival horror game that reminds us of Metroid: Other M (complimentary).
